welcome_lead: Roles in 1950 vs roles today — huge changes. 🔄

final_note: You learned how UK gender roles have shifted from the 1950s to today.

concepts.def: Woman who fought for the vote

walkthroughs.body_html:
In 1950s UK, men often worked, women often stayed home.

Married women often had to leave jobs.

Pay was openly lower for women.

Suffragettes won the vote in 1918 (some women), 1928 (all women).

Feminism waves since fought for equal pay, education and rights.

Today:

  • Women lead businesses and countries.
  • Men do more childcare.
  • Shared parenting leave from 2015.
  • Trans and non-binary identities more visible.

Still progress to make — but huge change. 🌈
